sections.value: NOTICE OF REQUISITION OF AN EXTRAORDINARY GENERAL MEETING PURSUANT TO SECTION __ OF THE COMPANIES AND ALLIED MATTERS ACT 20__

We, the undersigned, being holders of more than 10% of the paid-up capital of {name of company} limited carrying voting rights at the general meeting as at the date of this notice, require you to convene forthwith an extraordinary general meeting of {name of company} limited for the purpose of considering and, if thought fit, passing the following proposed resolutions:

We urge that all members of the Board of Directors proceed to convene the extraordinary general meeting of the Company within 21 days from receipt of this requisition, otherwise the undersigned shall proceed to convene the meeting in accordance with the provisions of the Companies and Allied Matters Act 20__, to pass the proposed resolutions.
